# Safety Cloud® integrations and partners

Activate Safety Cloud digital alerting through the tools you already use

## Digital alerting

Drivers receive [Safety Cloud alerts](https://www.haasalert.com/safety-cloud) directly in their cars through popular navigation applications, commercial driver safety systems, and the infotainment centers of leading automotive brands.

## The world's largest V2X launch

In 2023, Stellantis partnered with HAAS Alert to activate Safety Cloud on millions of vehicles, becoming the first automotive brand to make [V2X digital alerting](https://haasalert.com/integrations#) a standard safety feature.

![Safer Responses Graphic](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65ba9670d732a9fcbfe647cf/6706bd76120d999abf39de30_evahead.webp)

## Ask for Safety Cloud on any new build

Leading fleet manufacturers have added Safety Cloud to thousands of vehicles. But if your new build does not offer digital alerting as a standard safety feature, talk to your dealer to learn how to get equipped.

![Safer Responses Graphic](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65ba9670d732a9fcbfe647cf/6706bd8e0028a41efbb1d708_PierceTruck.webp)

## Connected arrow boards

Distracted driving is a common factor in work zone crashes. Safety Cloud comes standard on trailer-mounted arrow boards made by leading manufacturers to effectively alert drivers earlier to slow down and move over.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65ba9670d732a9fcbfe647cf/6706bdf653d36af7c76068d2_arrowboardlogos.webp)

![Safer Responses Graphic](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65ba9670d732a9fcbfe647cf/670fdd4e11bbbac701b5feb0_ConnectedArrowBoard.webp)

## Emergency vehicle preemption

Emergency vehicle preemption (EVP) communicates with traffic signals to automatically change lights to green for emergency vehicles. EVP can be added on to any emergency apparatus that is equipped with Safety Cloud through one of our trusted partners. This integration provides emergency vehicles with the best of both worlds.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65ba9670d732a9fcbfe647cf/69694e094e30f14586c9c70b_evppartners.webp)

![Safer Responses Graphic](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65ba9670d732a9fcbfe647cf/69694c27e88da495a06812f5_Preemption-1200x625.webp)
